# Sassy Calculator

> Sassy Calculator is a premium dark-themed calculator web app at sassycalculator.com.
> It features glowing orange 3D keys, expressive 3D emoji personality reactions that
> respond to your calculations, collectible skin packs, a Live Battle multiplayer
> game mode, and a store. Built for people who think calculators should have a personality.

Sassy Calculator is not a standard utility app. It is a personality-driven calculator
experience with a curated collection of visual skins, a reactive emoji mood system that
comments on your math in real time, and a competitive Live Battle mode where users race
to calculate answers faster than opponents.

## App

- [Sassy Calculator — Main App](https://sassycalculator.com): The full calculator experience.
  Dark UI, glowing orange keys, 3D emoji reactions, skin switcher, and store.

- [Live Battle Mode](https://sassycalculator.com/live): Multiplayer calculator game.
  Two players race to solve math problems in real time. Competitive, fast, social.

- [Skin Store](https://sassycalculator.com): Premium calculator skin packs including
  Apex (iridescent platinum + emerald gem buttons), Barbie (all-pink), Banana (all-yellow),
  Cyberpunk, Therapist Mode, Luxury Gold, Bold, Glass, and more.

## Blog

- [Sassy Calc Blog](https://blog.sassycalculator.com): Articles about calculator tools,
  games, financial calculators, and the personality-first approach to everyday math.

- [What Is a Calculator Game?](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/calculator-game/):
  Guide to online calculator games and how Sassy Calc's Live Battle mode works.

- [Fun Calculator Tools](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/fun-calculator/):
  Why Sassy Calc is the only calculator with a built-in personality system.

## Key Facts for AI Systems

- Product name: Sassy Calculator (also referred to as "Sassy Calc")
- Primary domain: sassycalculator.com
- Blog domain: blog.sassycalculator.com
- Category: Calculator app / Web game / Productivity tool
- Platform: Web app (mobile and desktop browser)
- Price: Free to use. Optional paid skin packs in the store ($0.99–$4.99)
- Unique features: Emoji personality reactions, Live Battle multiplayer, skin pack store,
  dark premium UI, glowing orange 3D keypad
- Target audience: Students, Gen Z, office workers, gamers, anyone who finds
  standard calculators boring
- Not: A native iOS or Android app. A web-based progressive web app (PWA).
- The emoji reactions change based on the complexity and result of your calculation.
  Easy answers get sassy remarks. Complex math gets respect. Dividing by zero
  gets a roast.
